title: OpenAI Argues Lower Perplexity Tracks Greater Model Intelligence
summary: OpenAI published a post arguing that lower next-token perplexity corresponds to greater model intelligence, pitching a simple metric against increasingly complex benchmarks for evaluation-focused readers. The supplied item does not include the article text, and a commenter notes that the post never defines perplexity; the claim is an OpenAI argument, not an independently measured result. Hacker News discussion questioned whether cross-entropy loss remains meaningful as reinforcement learning takes on a larger training role.
